title: Use this human life for the meeting it was given
summary: The shabad refuses to treat the body as decoration or machinery. Human birth is named as the chance to meet Gobind, so one ordinary day becomes urgent enough for Naam, service, and restraint.
takeaway: Let one embodied choice answer the chance to meet Gobind.
lifeApplication: Before maintenance swallows the day, choose one act that uses the body for meeting: remember Naam aloud, serve with your hands, or restrain the habit that wastes the hour.

source.shortMeaning: Human birth is given as the soul’s present chance to meet Gobind while breath is still available.
source.lifeApplication: Before maintenance swallows the day, use one embodied action to answer the gift of being here.

evidence.coreClaim: The cited lines define human life as a chance to meet Gobind, not as an ornament to maintain or display.
evidence.turn: Purpose becomes concrete when the body is used for the meeting this life was given to seek.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before maintenance swallows the day, choose one act that uses the body for meeting: remember Naam aloud, serve with your hands, or restrain the habit that wastes the hour.
